scripts.checks: tsc --outDir .tscheck --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop lib/graph/refs.ts lib/graph/graph.ts lib/graph/document.ts lib/view/variance.ts lib/view/areas.ts lib/checks/run.ts scripts/check-suite.ts && node .tscheck/scripts/check-suite.js
scripts.verify: tsc --outDir .tscheck --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop lib/graph/refs.ts lib/graph/graph.ts lib/graph/document.ts lib/view/variance.ts lib/view/areas.ts lib/checks/run.ts scripts/check-refs.ts scripts/check-integrity.ts scripts/check-locate.ts scripts/check-recompute.ts scripts/check-suite.ts && for s in check-refs check-integrity check-locate check-recompute check-suite; do echo "\n=== $s ==="; node .tscheck/scripts/$s.js; done
